source_method: Address/checker anomaly and mismatch controls; primary Ofcom/network/provider HTML guidance only; web-verified 2026-07-24; metadata-only
fixed_operations_global: No verified external-runner output; no duplicate retry
Ofcom, Openreach, CityFibre, KCOM, G.Network, Grain, BeFibre and OFNL retained
Prioritise exact address over maps/general area
Illustrative maps and neighbour results cannot prove serviceability
New builds and source-dataset refresh cycles can delay checker recognition
Preserve correction path without inventing coverage
Mismatch triggers recheck/support route, not inferred availability
No runtime score changed without real runner evidence
